hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve 1:1 ETH/phiEth swap hook that bypasses concentrated liquidity: it takes the full input from the PoolManager, wraps or unwraps ETH via the phiEth contract, and settles the output directly, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to no-op the normal swap path. Liquidity additions are blocked, and the pool is restricted to a zero-fee ETH/phiEth pair.
